description.value: Quick Shuttle runs daily cross-border coach service between Vancouver and Seattle year-round, with stops including Waterfront Station, Canada Place, River Rock Casino, and Surrey on the Canadian side, and SeaTac Airport, the piers, and downtown Seattle on the US side. The operator does not publish a bicycle-specific policy: bikes most likely travel as wrapped 'oversized/equipment' items (max 70 lbs/32 kg, space permitting) rather than as a named category, and no confirmed operator-stated fee could be found. Call ahead (1-800-665-2122) before travelling with a bike to confirm space, wrapping requirements, and current pricing.

wow_evidence: Scheduled cross-border coach between Vancouver and the US border on the Seattle corridor
